sections.heading: Why you'll love it here.
paragraphs: We're a product company building AI-driven technology for the insurance and roofing industries — from our base in Madhapur, Hyderabad.
Not slideware — production platforms like SoloScope, ClaimAssist and FBFS used by enterprise insurance and roofing clients every day.
React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Flutter, AWS and applied AI / LLMs. You work with the tools the best teams use, not legacy systems.
Small, senior team where your work is visible. Clear pathways, mentorship and ownership from day one — not years of waiting.
From AI property inspection to claims automation, what you build reaches real users — your code matters and you see the impact.

sections.heading: Everything you deserve.
paragraphs: Comprehensive medical, dental and vision for you and your family.
Generous holiday and recharge policy so you can do your best work.
An annual learning budget and protected time to grow your craft.
We celebrate your wins out loud — the big launches and the quiet fixes alike.
Remote-first with regional hubs and a generous home office setup.
A clear path forward, a mentor in your corner, and promotions you can see coming.
Quarterly off-sites, hack weeks, and demo days that bring us together.
A community where every voice shapes the company we are building.
